backup_intro: Download everything Jofi keeps as one zip file, or bring a backup back.
backup_export_warning: It contains all your data, your password hash, your stored API keys and the key that decrypts them. Store it like a password, for example in an encrypted folder, and never share it.
backup_export_dialog_intro: Enter your current password to confirm it is you. It is used for this download only and not stored.
backup_export_done: Backup downloaded as {name}. Keep it somewhere safe.
backup_restore_warning: Everything in Jofi is replaced by the backup: data, files, stored API keys and the password. Only restore backups you made yourself: whoever made a backup decides what your Jofi contains. You are logged out afterwards and log in with the password that was valid when the backup was made.
backup_staged_migrated: Made with the older schema {from}, migrated to this version
backup_restore_confirm: All data in Jofi will be replaced by the backup from {createdAt}: {rows} database rows and {files} files, {keyset}. You will be logged out. This cannot be undone.

login_restored: The backup was restored and every session has ended. Log in with the password that was valid when the backup was made.
backup_error_busy: Another backup download, upload or restore is running. Please try again in a moment.
backup_error_unavailable: Jofi could not read or write its backup storage. Nothing was changed; please try again.
backup_error_incomplete: The restore failed and could not be undone completely. Restart Jofi: it finishes undoing the restore at the next start.
backup_error_not_found: The uploaded backup is no longer waiting to be restored (a newer upload replaced it, or it expired). Please upload it again.
backup_error_mismatch: The server asked to confirm something other than this backup. Nothing was changed; please upload it again.
backup_refused_not_a_backup: This file is not a Jofi backup: it is not a readable zip file.
backup_refused_too_large: This backup is larger than this Jofi accepts. The limits are JOFI_BACKUP_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE and JOFI_BACKUP_MAX_UNPACKED_SIZE.
backup_refused_too_many_entries: This backup contains more files than this Jofi accepts (JOFI_BACKUP_MAX_ENTRIES).
backup_refused_unsafe_path: This backup contains a file path that is not allowed, so it was not made by Jofi or it was changed.
backup_refused_duplicate_entry: This backup contains the same file twice, so it was not made by Jofi or it was changed.
backup_refused_manifest_invalid: The backup's table of contents (manifest.json) is missing or unreadable.
backup_refused_unsupported_format: This Jofi version cannot read the format of this backup.
backup_refused_schema_older: This backup was made with an older Jofi and could not be migrated here. Restore it with the Jofi version it was made with, then upgrade.
backup_refused_schema_newer: This backup was made with a newer Jofi. Upgrade Jofi first, then restore it.
backup_refused_content_mismatch: The files in this backup do not match its table of contents: it is incomplete or was changed.
backup_refused_tables_mismatch: The tables in this backup are not the ones this Jofi version backs up.
backup_refused_keyset_missing: This backup contains stored API keys but not the key that decrypts them.
backup_refused_keyset_mismatch: The key in this backup does not decrypt the API keys stored in it.
backup_refused_data_invalid: The data in this backup does not fit the database: it is damaged or was changed.
backup_refused_account_missing: This backup does not contain exactly one user account, so nobody could log in after restoring it.
backup_restore_password_label: Current password, to confirm the restore
ai_intro: Jofi uses AI only through the providers you set up here. Only they receive your data, and entries you mark "never send to AI" never leave.
ai_base_url_description: The API address of your endpoint, for example http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
ai_base_url_required: Enter the base URL of the endpoint.
ai_base_url_invalid: Enter a full web address starting with https:// or http://.
ai_base_url_credentials: Leave out user names, passwords, "?" and "#": the key goes in its own field below.
ai_base_url_insecure: With http:// to another machine, your prompts and the key travel as plain text. Use https:// unless the endpoint is in a network you trust.
ai_key_description: Paste the key from your provider's console. Jofi stores it encrypted and never shows it again.
ai_key_optional: Only if your endpoint needs one. Jofi stores it encrypted and never shows it again.
ai_key_stored: A key is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or enter a new one to replace it.
ai_key_reenter: The base URL now points to another server. Enter the API key again, so it only goes where you meant it to.
ai_privacy_cloud: Everything Jofi sends for an AI task goes to this provider's servers and is handled under its terms.
ai_privacy_compatible: Where your data goes depends on the endpoint: a server on your own machine keeps it there, a hosted service handles it under its own terms.
ai_provider_delete_confirm: Jofi removes "{name}", its stored API key and its model list. Costs already recorded stay.
ai_error_not_found: This provider no longer exists. Reload the page.
ai_error_in_use: Tasks still use this provider. Give them another model first, then remove it.
ai_error_forbidden: Only you can change the AI setup, not an AI or an external client.
ai_error_authentication_failed: The provider refused the API key. Check it, enter it again under Edit, and test again.
ai_error_rate_limited: The provider is throttling requests right now. Wait a moment and test again.
ai_error_unreachable: Jofi could not reach the provider, or the address is not allowed. Check the base URL and your network.
ai_error_rejected: The provider refused to list its models. Check the base URL and the key.
ai_error_storage: The AI setup cannot be saved right now. Try again in a moment.
ai_error_invalid: Some input was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
ai_error_mismatch: The server asked to confirm something else, so nothing was done. Reload the page and try again.
ai_violation_not_allowed: This provider does not take this field.
ai_violation_out_of_range: This value is out of range.
ai_violation_invalid_format: This value has the wrong format.
ai_group_cheap_description: Many small calls, for example scoring every new job the scanners find. A small, cheap model is enough.
ai_group_strong_description: Longer texts and conversations: your CV, cover letters, interviews and the chat. Pick a strong model with tool use and a long context.
ai_group_search_description: Embeddings let Jofi find similar jobs and duplicates. Needs an embedding model.
ai_group_voice_description: Speech to text and text to speech for spoken interview training. Optional; you can add it later.
ai_tasks_no_models: No models known yet. Add a provider and test its connection: Jofi then lists its models here.

ai_budget_description: When the month's AI costs reach the cap, Jofi pauses non-essential jobs such as scanner scoring until the next month.

ai_prices_intro: Endpoints such as Ollama or OpenRouter have no list price, so Jofi cannot tell what their calls cost. Give a model its price (0 for one that runs on your machine): its calls then show in the costs and count toward the monthly cap.

wizard_welcome_guide: Hi, I'm Jofi's donkey. Before I can score jobs or draft letters for you, I need an AI to think with. Let's set one up together; it takes about five minutes.
wizard_welcome_point_providers: You choose who does the thinking: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, or a model on your own machine (Ollama, LM Studio …).
wizard_welcome_point_privacy: Only the providers you add ever receive your data. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
wizard_welcome_point_later: Every step saves right away. You can skip now and continue any time under Settings.
wizard_providers_guide: Which AI should I use? Pick a provider, read what happens with your data there, then paste your key (or the address of your local server). "Test connection" checks that I can reach it.
wizard_tasks_guide: Not every job needs the biggest brain. Small, cheap models are fine for quick checks; letters and interviews deserve a strong one. I'll warn you if a model lacks something a task needs.
wizard_budget_guide: Want a safety net? Set a monthly cap and I'll pause the non-essential jobs when it's reached. This step is optional.
wizard_done_guide: That's it! Here is what we set up. You can change all of it later under Settings.
